biological.citation: Marcogliese et al. 2022 - Loss of IRF2BPL impairs neuronal maintenance through excess Wnt signaling (PMID: 35044823)
biological.summary: In Drosophila and zebrafish, IRF2BPL and its ortholog Pits repress Wnt transcription. Neuronal loss of Pits raises wingless levels and causes axonal loss, and Wg inhibition is neuroprotective. Zebrafish irf2bpl loss increases wnt1 signaling, and patient astrocytes show increased WNT1. IRF2BPL physically and genetically interacts with the Wnt antagonist CKIα.

biological.citation: Ginevrino/Tsai et al. 2022 - Mechanisms of IRF2BPL-related disorders and identification of a potential therapeutic strategy (PMID: 36476864)
biological.summary: In patient fibroblast-derived astrocytes and neurons, full-length IRF2BPL is nuclear. Truncated NEDAMSS variants sequester wild-type protein to the cytoplasm and cause aggregation. Patient astrocytes fail to support neuronal survival and show mitochondrial and respiratory dysfunction, which CuATSM rescues. In flies, truncated IRF2BPL causes cytoplasmic accumulation of full-length protein, and heterozygous Pits truncations cause progressive motor defects that CuATSM ameliorates.

biological.citation: Marcogliese et al. 2018 - IRF2BPL Is Associated with Neurological Phenotypes (PMID: 30057031)
biological.summary: The fly ortholog pits is broadly expressed, including in the nervous system. Complete loss of pits is lethal early in development, and neuronal RNAi knockdown causes neurodegeneration. Patient nonsense variants act as severe loss-of-function alleles in flies, while missense variants give a range of phenotypes.

biological.citation: Gastric cancer study 2018 - Forkhead Box F2 Suppresses Gastric Cancer through a Novel FOXF2-IRF2BPL-β-Catenin Signaling Axis (PMID: 29374064)
biological.summary: FOXF2 directly binds the IRF2BPL promoter and induces its transcription. IRF2BPL, an E3 ligase, interacts with β-catenin and increases its ubiquitination and degradation, which blunts Wnt signaling in gastric cancer cells.

biological.citation: 2022 - N(6)-methyladenosine-modified circRNA RERE modulates osteoarthritis by regulating β-catenin ubiquitination and degradation (PMID: 35733354)
biological.summary: circRERE sponges miR-195-5p to upregulate IRF2BPL, which promotes β-catenin ubiquitination and degradation in chondrocytes. In a mouse DMM osteoarthritis model, AAV-sh-Irf2bpl worsened OA and the β-catenin inhibitor ICG-001 reversed this effect.

biological.citation: 2025 - IRF2BPL inhibits proliferation, migration and invasion of osteosarcoma cells by inhibiting FOSL2-mediated PI3K/AKT pathway activation (PMID: 40834975)
biological.summary: IRF2BPL is downregulated in osteosarcoma and correlates with patient survival. Overexpression suppresses proliferation, migration and invasion in vitro and in xenografts, and silencing enhances them. It acts by promoting ubiquitin-mediated degradation of FOSL2, thereby inhibiting PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling.

biological.citation: 2025 - IRF2BPL transcriptionally regulates IGFBP2 to promote tumor progression and suppresses immune cell infiltration in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (PMID: 41413713)
biological.summary: IRF2BPL is highly expressed in ESCC cells and acts as a transcriptional activator of IGFBP2, promoting tumor progression in vitro and in vivo and reducing immune cell infiltration. ONC201 impedes the progression driven by the IRF2BPL-IGFBP2 axis.

biological.citation: 2021 - Identification and Functional Characterization of a Novel Androgen Receptor Coregulator, EAP1 (PMID: 34585037)
biological.summary: EAP1 (IRF2BPL) was identified by rapid immunoprecipitation mass spectrometry as a labile AR interactor. It enhances AR transcriptional activity through E3 ubiquitin ligase activity, with AR and HDAC1 as ubiquitination substrates. Its expression correlates with AR expression and poor prognosis in prostate cancer specimens.

biological.citation: 2020 - Neurodevelopmental disorder caused by a truncating de novo variant of IRF2BPL (PMID: 33278788)
biological.summary: Bioinformatic PPI network analysis links IRF2BPL to IRF2 and 10 other genes and to ubiquitin binding. The truncating variant altered the cellular localization of IRF2BPL and significantly decreased ubiquitinated protein levels, suggesting impaired ubiquitin-proteasome function.

biological.citation: 2024 - IRF2BPL-Related Disorder (NEDAMSS) Is Characterized by Pathology Consistent with DRPLA (PMID: 39224955)
biological.summary: The p.Arg188Ter variant gives variable mRNA levels by cell type, with decreased mRNA in brain, and destabilizes the protein in patient-derived cells. Postmortem brain showed DRPLA-like pathology with polyQ inclusions, suggesting a role for the IRF2BPL polyQ tract.
